thread:
oliver: quick follow-up from autoscaler RFC prototyping. I sketched a hybrid: tiny local delegate + central coordinator. want quick sanity on failure modes.
kim: delegate vs central responsibilities?
oliver: delegate = immediate admission, local headroom counters, probe-warmup. central = persistent leases, global fairness, minting short tokens for admission.
maya: how do we handle coordinator partitions? last canary had double-admits.
oliver: central mints time-limited tokens (ttl 10s). delegates require tokens to admit. if coordinator unreachable >30s, delegates switch to local_cautious: cached tokens + conservative headroom.
raj: alternative optimistic admission?
oliver: optimistic reduces latency but needs reconciler to evict which causes user-visible failures. tokens add slight admission latency but fewer rollbacks.
kim: burst strategy?
oliver: per-tenant burst credits plus shared spillover pool. delegates use tenant credits then request spillover token from central.
maya: reduce prewarm cost with probe-warmup: tiny probe requests to populate KV cache when queue growth >20% over 15s.
raj: eviction flow? avoid abrupt disconnects.
oliver: soft-first: stop new burst admits, mark draining, wait inflight tokens to expire, soft-evict low-priority sessions with 5s notice, then force if needed. API: POST /v1/evict {pool,mode,targets,deadline_ms}.
kim: force-drain emergency needs audit. ops-bot should emit event and require two approvers.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: autoscaler/delegate v0.3.4 -> canary pool-alpha.
maya: metrics to add: credits_used, local_headroom_free, probe_success_rate, token_mint_latency, reconcile_conflicts_count, admission_downgrade_count.
raj: rollback gates: reconcile_conflicts_count >5/min or probe_failure_rate >20% for 10m.
oliver: decision summary: delegates with ephemeral state + token admission; central persists leases and mints tokens; probe-warmup; burst credits + spillover; soft-first eviction + two-approver force; canary gates.
kim: I'll dashboard alerts for reconcile_conflicts_count.
maya: I'll write the failure playbook and SDK error shape.
raj: schedule 30m tomorrow to review canary checklist.
oliver: thanks, ping if edge cases appear. :thumbsup:
